params.name: buildNum
params.description: Filled with the internal build/compilation number of the running 4D application.
If present, return the long (8-character) version string instead of the short (4-character) one.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns an encoded version-number string for the running 4D environment (short 4-char form by default, or long 8-char form with the * flag), optionally also filling buildNum with the internal build number.

constraints: Without the * parameter, returns a 4-character string (version, 'R' number, revision); with * present, returns an 8-character string additionally prefixed with a final/beta flag and internal compilation number.
For applications compiled and merged with 4D Volume Desktop, the returned buildNum is not significant -- version info is managed by the developer in that context.
